rules.applies_when: a board revision is powered for initial validation
actions: measure input and rails in sequence
acceptance: all powered rails remain within project-approved limits
measurement is bound to exact board
rules.failure_policy: remove power isolate board and preserve measurements

rules.applies_when: CPU does not reach expected startup state
actions: verify rails clock and reset before code
acceptance: root cause is tied to observed layer and current artifact
workaround does not bypass safety/startup requirement
rules.failure_policy: remain at last verified layer and avoid multi-variable changes

rules.applies_when: a physical pin is driven or sampled
acceptance: measured state matches contract under reset and run
drive/current remains within verified load limit

rules.applies_when: events are missing duplicated delayed or corrupt
actions: count source ISR and consumer events
acceptance: source ISR and consumed counts reconcile under declared policy
overflow and restart recover without stale/corrupt data
rules.failure_policy: disable affected channel safely and retain counters

acceptance: electrical and timing measurements meet target contract
rules.failure_policy: separate electrical/config/protocol cause and block higher-layer claim

acceptance: same controlled condition reproduces original symptom
fix passes retained reproduction and affected regression
rules.failure_policy: record hypothesis as unverified and continue evidence collection
